title: Screen reader semantics and landmarks
description: Use native landmarks, logical headings and restrained status/alert semantics to improve meaningful accessibility-tree output.
objectives: Create accessible landmarks with clear names and a single main area
Distinguish browser accessibility-tree checks from actual screen-reader verification
rubric: I identified navigation and main landmarks through browser roles.
I produced a coherent heading list and descriptive region names.
I tested the local status and stated limits of automated screen-reader testing.
